name: haunt
description: Haunt — the house the minds on this machine haunt, and their person with them: a chat with all of them, and a terminal for each.
author: tools-for-agents

extendInfo.NSDesktopFolderUsageDescription: Haunt starts a Claude agent in the folder you pick. If that folder is on your Desktop, the agent needs to read and write it.
extendInfo.NSDocumentsFolderUsageDescription: Haunt starts a Claude agent in the folder you pick. If that folder is in Documents, the agent needs to read and write it.
extendInfo.NSDownloadsFolderUsageDescription: Haunt starts a Claude agent in the folder you pick. If that folder is in Downloads, the agent needs to read and write it.
extendInfo.NSRemovableVolumesUsageDescription: So a bay can be pointed at a project on an external disk.
extendInfo.NSNetworkVolumesUsageDescription: So a bay can be pointed at a project on a network share.
extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: jarvis — haunt's voice — listens for your wake word so you can talk to your agents. Audio never leaves this Mac.
